name: What kind of paint do you use for interior projects?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint do you use for interior projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: We primarily use high-quality, durable, and low-VOC (volatile organic compound) paints from reputable brands. This ensures a long-lasting finish and minimizes odors, contributing to better indoor air quality. We can discuss various paint types, finishes (e.g., flat, eggshell, satin, semi-gloss), and brands to match your aesthetic preferences and practical needs during our consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use high-quality, durable, low-VOC paints from reputable brands, and can discuss various types and finishes.
